question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

I had to wake up in the middle of the night to **go to the toilet.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Answer the call of nature"** means to go to the toilet. (शौचालय जाना)

 
 
• **Example: **During the long road trip, we had to stop several times to **answer the call of nature.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Spill the beans** (राज़ खोलना): Reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly.

 
 
• **Example:** She spilled the beans about the surprise party by accident.
 
 
 
• **Lost cause** (असफल प्रयास): Something that has no chance of succeeding.
 
 
• **Example: **Trying to change his mind is a lost cause; he is very stubborn.
 
 
 
• **Break a leg** (शुभकामनाएँ देना): A way to wish someone good luck, especially before a performance.
 
 
• **Example:** Before her big presentation, her friends told her to break a leg.
